Agent Browser 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Introduces a fast Rust-based headless browser CLI with Node.js fallback.
- Enables automation for navigation, interaction (click, type, fill forms), page snapshots, and more via structured commands.
- Supports web UI testing, data extraction, file upload, authentication workflows, and video/screenshot recording.
- Offers semantic locators, network interception, tab/window control, and state management features.
- Ships with extensive CLI documentation and workflow examples for rapid adoption.
